mobwalk.config.generic.comment.enabled: If enabled, shows the standable-surface overlay when holding a stick.
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.mobProfil: Which mob hitbox and vertical jump distance the walkable area is calculated for. Does NOT account for horizontal movement when jumping (ie parkour).
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.floodRadi: How far the selection spreads from the clicked block. Large values may impact performance.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.walkab: Color and transparency of walkable surfaces.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showBe: If enabled, shows beams through solid blocks.
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.showHo: If enabled, draws vertical beams at holes (drops a mob cannot escape).
mobwalk.config.appearance.comment.holeBe: Color and transparency of hole beams.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchSeeTh: If enabled, while crouching, shows walkable surfaces through walls.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchScrol: If enabled, while crouching with a stick, scrolling changes the flood radius.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchCycle: If enabled, while crouching with a stick, right-clicking air cycles the mob profile.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.shadeByDept: If enabled, colors surfaces by the BFS flood depth from the seed. Mostly for debugging connectivity, as the rainbow hues are distracting.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.showCutoffR: If enabled, shows the grey outermost flood-radius rings (inconclusive neighbor relationships).
